resources.string: Check the website address. Enter only the secure website address, without anything after the name.

On Home, go one page past Files and open Passwords to manage your saved sign-ins. Choose a sign-in to find Show password and Copy password. To fill one, open Private sign-in on a secure website and tap the password field. If Android offers Grace Passwords, unlock your tablet and choose the sign-in you want. Then use the website’s sign-in button.
